messages:
tess: Heads-up: launch kickoff tomorrow AM. Need final signoffs for staging->prod listing promotion across AWS/GCP/Azure. Main open items: metering dimension names, staging manifest tag, telemetry hooks, and legal signoff for embedded trial.

leo: Metering: prefer to use metric_name=redwood_inference_tokens and dimension plan_id. AWS uses UsageRecords, GCP uses GoogleCloudMarketplaceMetering API, Azure uses Metering Dimensions in offer. We should normalize our plan_ids across clouds to avoid translation table later.

anya: Normalization ACK. I'll publish a canonical mapping CSV to s3://redwood-pub/onboard/marketplace_plan_map_176998.csv with columns: canonical_plan_id, aws_sku, gcp_plan, azure_plan, price_tier, region_lock.

marc: Telemetry: Product wants these events emitted from the listing landing page: listing_view, start_trial_click, checkout_initiated. Need to confirm we can pass campaign_source and sku_id through the redirect. Also want an initial GA4 + internal event bus forwarder.

tess: Can devops ensure the redirect preserves query params? We do not want to lose campaign attribution.

devops-bot: Redirect verified: publisher flow can preserve UTM and sku_id if we use POST then 302 with original query string appended. Staging test at https://staging-pub.redwood.com/onboard/176998 - sample flow log attached.

leo: One gotcha: AWS storefront sandbox strips certain query params on the first click if you use AWS-auth redirect. We should test with a sample 3rd-party campaign link.

anya: I've added a test campaign link to the CSV and flagged aws_auth=true for that row.

marc: Legal: are we collecting payment info at trial enrollment? If yes, need explicit billing consent copy and VAT clause for EU buyers. Azure vs GCP differences?

legal-bot: Legal: trials without payment collection are simpler. If collecting billing info, ensure billing_consent_text and vat_notice fields populated for EU. Please attach localized EULAs (FR/DE/ES) and indicate yes/no for billing collection in the manifest.

tess: We will NOT collect payment info for the free trial. Update manifest manifest_staging.json with "collects_billing": false. Legal, can you confirm that removes VAT requirement for trial opt-in?

legal-bot: Confirmed: if no payment is accepted up-front then VAT clause only applies when converting to paid. Add conversion_notice in localized EULA.

anya: Staging manifest uploaded: s3://redwood-pub/onboard/manifest_staging_176998.json. Key fields: listing_id, version=0.9.0-staging, collects_billing=false, canonical_plan_map_s3.

devops-bot: Preflight run results: images ok, description length within limits (aws_short=140, gcp_short=120, azure_short=135), no icon rasterization issues. Staging tag created: onboard-176998-staging.

leo: We need a rollback tag process: if prod fails we should roll back listing to previous version within 15 minutes. Can we automate via publisher API?

devops-bot: Rollback playbook: promote previous manifest via API call /publisher/promote with param version=<previous> and wait_for_status=published. Automation: we can run a lambda that triggers on monitoring alert. I'll add runbook to Confluence.

marc: Monitoring: set up early-warning metrics: drop in start_trial_click rate, increase in checkout_error_4xx. Alert to #incidents since this affects revenue.

anya: I also included an entry for region_exclusions in the CSV. Some GCP SKUs are not available in europe-west3, Azure has marketplace restriction in china regions.

tess: Final checklist for tomorrow AM: 1) legal localized copy in legal ticket link 2) manifest_staging -> test flows green 3) telemetry hooked to GA4 + event bus 4) plan_map CSV in S3 5) owner accounts set on each publisher portal. Assign owners?

leo: I'll own AWS publisher actions.

anya: I'll own GCP publishing and the CSV mapping.

marc: I'll own telemetry and alerts.

legal-bot: Legal lead assigned: @grace from contracts. Grace will post localized EULA attachments to the legal ticket by 09:00 PT.

tess: Great. If anyone hits a blocker tonight DM me. We'll do a 20-min sync 08:30 PT tomorrow. :rocket:
